# Text comparison

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/text-compare/

Compare two texts line by line and highlight additions and removals. Review changes without sending a document to a server.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Compare the original and edited versions of a short description to see which lines were replaced.

## Limits and checks

The comparison supports up to 400 lines per input and is line-based rather than a word-level document redline.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
